title: Hungry Harmonious German Kinako Wrap
description: A sour, crispy, and light German dish featuring kinako, ssam-wrap, and kosher-friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick snack or lunch
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together kinako, rye flour, and salt
Gradually add in water to form a dough
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces
Roll out each piece into a thin sheet
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook each sheet for 1-2 minutes on each side
In a separate pan, heat the sauerkraut and pickles over medium heat until warmed through
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of sauerkraut and pickles on each sheet, then sprinkling with caraway seeds
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
